description: Pet Care All. WHEN: perform all available FREE pet maintenance actions in one atomic call (routines: standard, train, pamper). Reuses pet_feed, pet_play, pet_clean, pet_rest, pet_teach with no new costs; skips actions on cooldown or at limit, and reports per-action status. Example: pet_care_all {}

key.description: Your arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

routine.description: Routine: 'standard' (all 5 maintenance actions: feed, play, clean, rest, teach), 'train' (feed, rest, play, teach — skips clean), or 'pamper' (feed, clean, rest, play — skips teach). Default 'standard'.
